drawings.description: croquis : une droite de base portant trois points, notés \uncertain{$t_1$}, \uncertain{$y_0$} et $\bar{\eta}$ ; au-dessus de chacun une fibre verticale — celle de $t_1$ se recoupe elle-même, celle de $\bar{\eta}$ est hachurée —, et une courbe transverse, marquée $\tilde{z}$, qui les coupe toutes les trois
drawings.kind: fibres over a base line, with a transverse curve
drawings.notes: A base line with three points, labelled t_1, y_0 and bar eta (the first two uncertain, as in the transcription); above each a vertical fibre: that of t_1 drawn as two strokes crossing each other, that of bar eta doubled and hatched with a zigzag (drawn as a zigzag between its two strokes, in pencil); a transverse curve, z tilde, crossing all three near the top. The point over y_0 is a dot on the base line; over bar eta the base line is thickened.

drawings.description: au-dessous, un croquis : deux traits verticaux, l'un simple, l'autre doublé et rempli d'un zigzag, au-dessus d'un trait horizontal.
drawings.kind: two vertical strokes over a base line
drawings.notes: A plain vertical stroke on the left; on the right a narrow vertical strip (two strokes close together) filled by a zigzag over its upper two thirds; under both, a horizontal stroke. On the page the vertical strokes stop a little above the horizontal one (the transcription's note says they stand on it): drawn as on the page. No label. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: au bas du feuillet, deux petits croquis : un cercle traversé par un axe vertical et, en son centre, par un arc épais oblique, un point marqué sur l'axe sous le cercle ; un cercle centré sur un axe vertical, le centre marqué.
drawings.notes: Left: a circle on a vertical axis that runs well below it; a heavy oblique arc crosses the circle through its centre, from outside on the left to outside on the lower right; a small point on the axis below the circle. Right: a circle centred on a vertical axis, its centre marked by a point. Axis, arc and circle of the left figure pass through the same computed centre. No label. The transcription's note matches. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
